Implement the following plan:

# Workflow Builder - Implementation Plan

## Context

TPMJS has a rich tool registry, agents, and collections system. Users can already compose tools into agents and collections. But there's no way to visually design multi-step pipelines where tools execute in sequence, with data flowing between them, conditional branching, loops, and real-time execution visualization.

This workflow builder fills that gap. Unlike n8n/Dify/Langflow which start from LLM chains or SaaS integrations, TPMJS starts from a **tool registry** - every tool has JSON schemas, so the builder can auto-generate node configurations and suggest compatible connections.

**Goal**: A visual drag-and-drop workflow canvas (React Flow) where users wire together tools, agents, conditions, and transforms, then run them with real-time node-by-node progress.

---

## Phase 1: Data Model + CRUD + List/Create Pages

### 1.1 Prisma Schema

**File**: `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma`

Add enums and 5 new models:

```
WorkflowStatus: DRAFT | ACTIVE | ARCHIVED
WorkflowTriggerType: MANUAL | WEBHOOK | SCHEDULE
WorkflowNodeType: TRIGGER | TOOL | AGENT | CONDITION | LOOP | TRANSFORM | OUTPUT | NOTE
WorkflowExecutionStatus: PENDING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED | CANCELLED
WorkflowNodeExecutionStatus: PENDING | RUNNING | COMPLETED | FAILED | SKIPPED
```

**Workflow** - top-level definition owned by user
- `uid` (unique, URL-friendly), `name`, `description`, `status`
- `triggerType` + `triggerConfig` (JSON)
- `canvasViewport` (JSON - persists React Flow zoom/pan)
- `version` (incremented on each save)
- `executorType` + `executorConfig` (optional, cascade from existing system)
- `envVars` (JSON)
- `executionCount`, `lastExecutedAt` (denormalized)
- Relations: `nodes[]`, `edges[]`, `executions[]`
- Indexes: `userId`, `uid`, `status`
- Unique: `[userId, name]`

**WorkflowNode** - individual nodes in the graph
- `workflowId`, `nodeId` (React Flow ID, unique within workflow)
- `type` (WorkflowNodeType enum)
- `label`, `positionX`, `positionY`
- `config` (JSON - varies by node type)
- `toolId` (optional FK to Tool), `agentId` (optional FK to Agent)
- Unique: `[workflowId, nodeId]`

**WorkflowEdge** - connections between nodes
- `workflowId`, `edgeId` (React Flow edge ID)
- `sourceNodeId`, `targetNodeId` (FK to WorkflowNode)
- `sourceHandle`, `targetHandle` (for branching: "true", "false", etc.)
- `dataMapping` (JSON - template expressions like `{{source.output.field}}`)
- Unique: `[workflowId, edgeId]`

**WorkflowExecution** - a single run
- `workflowId`, `status`, `triggeredBy`
- `triggerInput`, `output`, `error` (JSON)
- `startedAt`, `completedAt`, `durationMs`
- `totalTokensIn`, `totalTokensOut`
- `workflowVersion` (snapshot)

**WorkflowNodeExecution** - per-node result within a run
- `executionId`, `nodeId` (FK to WorkflowNode)
- `status`, `input`, `output`, `error` (JSON)
- `startedAt`, `completedAt`, `durationMs`
- `attempt`, `maxRetries`

Also add `workflows Workflow[]` relation to User model and `WORKFLOW_CREATED`, `WORKFLOW_UPDATED`, `WORKFLOW_DELETED`, `WORKFLOW_EXECUTED` to `ActivityType` enum.

### 1.2 Sidebar Navigation

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardLayout.tsx`

Add `{ href: '/dashboard/workflows', label: 'Workflows', icon: 'barChart' }` to first nav section, after Collections (line 30). Will also add a `gitFork` icon entry that better fits the workflow concept if time permits.

### 1.3 Workflows List Page

**File**: `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/page.tsx`

Follow exact pattern from `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/agents/page.tsx`:
- `DashboardLayout` wrapper with "New Workflow" button
- Table columns: Name (icon + name + description), Status (Badge: Draft/Active/Archived), Nodes count, Last Run (relative time), Actions (Run + Delete)
- Loading skeleton (3 rows), empty state with CTA
- Fetch from `GET /api/workflows`
- Click row -> navigate to `/dashboard/workflows/[id]`

### 1.4 Create Workflow Page

**File**: `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/new/page.tsx`

Follow pattern from `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/agents/new/page.tsx`:
- Form fields: Name, UID (auto-generated from name), Description, Trigger Type (Select: Manual/Webhook/Schedule)
- POST to `/api/workflows`, redirect to `/dashboard/workflows/[id]`

### 1.5 API Routes

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/route.ts`**
- GET: list user workflows with `_count: { nodes: true }`, `take: limit + 1` pagination
- POST: create workflow, Zod validation, generate UID, check `[userId, name]` uniqueness

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/route.ts`**
- GET: full workflow with nodes + edges included
- PATCH: update metadata (name, description, status, triggerConfig, envVars)
- DELETE: cascade delete

All routes: `export const runtime = 'nodejs'`, `authenticateRequest()`, standard `{success, data, error}` response format.

### 1.6 Sequence
1. Schema changes -> `pnpm --filter=@tpmjs/db db:generate && pnpm --filter=@tpmjs/db db:push`
2. API routes
3. Pages (list + create)
4. Sidebar update

---

## Phase 2: React Flow Canvas

### 2.1 Dependencies

Add `@xyflow/react` to `apps/web/package.json`.

### 2.2 Canvas Page

**File**: `apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/[id]/page.tsx`

Uses `DashboardLayout` with `fullHeight={true}` (same pattern as agent chat page). Structure:

```
DashboardLayout (fullHeight)
  WorkflowCanvas
    +-- NodePalette (left sidebar, ~220px, collapsible)
    +-- ReactFlow (center, flex-1)
    +-- NodeInspector (right panel, ~320px, shown when node selected)
    +-- WorkflowToolbar (top overlay bar)
```

### 2.3 Components

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/`

**`WorkflowCanvas.tsx`** - main orchestrator
- React Flow state: nodes, edges, onNodesChange, onEdgesChange, onConnect
- Loads workflow from `GET /api/workflows/[id]` on mount
- Debounced auto-save (2s) via `PUT /api/workflows/[id]/graph`
- Selected node state -> drives NodeInspector
- Drag-and-drop from palette (`onDragOver` + `onDrop`)

**`NodePalette.tsx`** - left sidebar
- Categorized sections: Triggers, Tools, Logic, Agents, Output
- Search input at top (filters all categories)
- **Tools section**: Loads from `/api/tools/search?q=...` with debounced search
- **Agents section**: Loads from `/api/agents` (user's agents)
- Each item is draggable (HTML5 drag API with `dataTransfer`)
- Compact list items showing icon + name + description

**`NodeInspector.tsx`** - right panel
- Renders when a node is selected
- Dispatches to type-specific inspector components
- Header with node type badge + label input
- Delete node button

**`WorkflowToolbar.tsx`** - top bar
- Save button with status indicator (Saved / Saving... / Unsaved)
- Run button (green, triggers execution)
- Status badge (DRAFT/ACTIVE)
- Workflow name (editable inline)
- Back button to workflows list

### 2.4 Custom Node Types

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/`

All nodes share consistent styling: rounded border, colored header bar by type, icon, label, handles.

| Node | Icon | Color | Handles | Special |
|------|------|-------|---------|---------|
| `TriggerNode` | `send` | blue | 1 output (bottom) | Shows trigger type badge |
| `ToolNode` | `puzzle` | purple | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows tool name + package |
| `AgentNode` | `terminal` | green | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows agent name + model |
| `ConditionNode` | `gitFork` | amber | 1 input (top), N outputs (bottom, labeled) | Diamond-ish shape |
| `LoopNode` | `loader` | teal | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows "Loop over..." |
| `TransformNode` | `edit` | slate | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows transform label |
| `OutputNode` | `check` | emerald | 1 input (top) | Rounded bottom |
| `NoteNode` | `message` | yellow | No handles | Resizable text area |

Each node includes a small status dot (for execution overlay) - grey by default, animated during runs.

### 2.5 Custom Edge

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/edges/DataEdge.tsx`

Bezier edge with:
- Default: solid line with subtle arrow
- During execution: animated dashes (CSS animation)
- Optional label showing data mapping preview

### 2.6 Graph Save API

**File**: `apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/graph/route.ts`

`PUT /api/workflows/[id]/graph` - bulk save:
- Accepts `{ nodes: [...], edges: [...], canvasViewport: {x,y,zoom} }`
- Prisma transaction: delete all existing nodes/edges, create new ones
- Validates ownership
- Increments `version`

This is the primary save endpoint. Auto-save debounces to 2s after any change.

---

## Phase 3: Node Configuration & Data Mapping

### 3.1 Inspector Components

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/`

**`ToolNodeInspector.tsx`** - the star feature
- Fetches tool details (incl. `inputSchema`) from `/api/tools/[toolId]`
- Auto-generates form from JSON Schema using `SchemaFormGenerator`
- Each field has a toggle: "Static value" vs "Map from upstream"
- Static: renders appropriate input (Input, Select, Switch, Textarea based on type)
- Mapped: dropdown of available upstream outputs using `{{nodeId.output.path}}` syntax
- Shows tool description, package name, health status

**`AgentNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Dropdown to select agent (from `/api/agents`)
- Prompt template (Textarea, supports `{{input.field}}` interpolation)
- Shows agent model/provider as Badge

**`ConditionNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Field selector (from upstream outputs)
- Operator dropdown (`===`, `!==`, `>`, `<`, `includes`, `exists`)
- Value input
- "Add Branch" button for multi-way conditions
- Each branch auto-creates a new output handle on the node

**`LoopNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Array path selector (dropdown of upstream array outputs)
- Max iterations input (default 100, safety cap)

**`TransformNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Output field mapping: table of `fieldName -> expression`
- Add/remove field rows
- Expression uses `{{input.field}}` syntax

**`OutputNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Label input
- Optional output schema preview

### 3.2 Schema Form Generator

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/SchemaFormGenerator.tsx`

Reusable component that takes a JSON Schema and renders form fields:
- `string` -> `Input`
- `number` -> `Input[type=number]`
- `boolean` -> `Switch`
- `enum` -> `Select`
- `array` -> list with "Add Item" button
- `object` -> nested fieldset (recursive)
- Each field supports static value OR mapped expression toggle

### 3.3 Upstream Output Resolution

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useUpstreamOutputs.ts`

Given a node ID and the current graph, walks backward through edges to find all upstream nodes and their output schemas. Returns a structured list for data mapping dropdowns.

---

## Phase 4: Execution Engine

### 4.1 Core Engine

**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/execute.ts`

```ts
async function executeWorkflow(
  workflowId: string,
  triggerInput: Record<string, unknown>,
  userId: string,
  onNodeStatus: (nodeId: string, status, output?) => void
): Promise<WorkflowExecutionResult>
```

Algorithm:
1. Load workflow with nodes + edges
2. Build adjacency list
3. Topological sort (Kahn's algorithm) -> execution order
4. Group by level (same-level nodes = parallel)
5. For each level, execute all nodes with `Promise.all`:
   - Resolve inputs via data mapping from upstream outputs
   - Execute node based on type
   - Store output in context map
   - Fire `onNodeStatus` callback
6. Return final output from Output nodes

**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/topological-sort.ts` - Kahn's algorithm
**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/data-mapping.ts` - resolve `{{nodeId.output.path}}` templates

### 4.2 Node Executors

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/node-executors/`

| Executor | What it does |
|----------|-------------|
| `trigger.ts` | Returns triggerInput as-is |
| `tool.ts` | Calls `executeWithExecutor()` from `lib/executors` - reuses the entire existing execution system |
| `agent.ts` | One-shot `generateText` call with agent config, similar to conversation route |
| `condition.ts` | Evaluates expression, returns `{ branch: 'true'/'false'/label }` |
| `loop.ts` | Iterates array, executing downstream subgraph per item |
| `transform.ts` | Applies field mapping |
| `output.ts` | Passes through input |

Key: Tool execution reuses `executeWithExecutor()` and `resolveExecutorConfig()` from `apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts`. Agent execution reuses `createToolDefinition()` and `buildAgentTools()` patterns.

### 4.3 Execution API

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/execute/route.ts`**
- POST: starts execution, streams SSE progress events
- `export const maxDuration = 300` (5 min)
- SSE events: `node_start`, `node_complete`, `node_error`, `workflow_complete`, `workflow_error`

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/executions/route.ts`**
- GET: paginated execution history

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/executions/[executionId]/route.ts`**
- GET: single execution with all node results

### 4.4 Execution Overlay

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useWorkflowExecution.ts`

React hook that:
- Opens EventSource to `/api/workflows/[id]/execute`
- Maintains `nodeStatuses: Map<nodeId, {status, output, duration}>`
- Returns `{ isRunning, nodeStatuses, runWorkflow, lastExecution }`

The node components read from this to show status indicators (blue pulse = running, green check = done, red X = failed).

---

## Phase 5: Polish & Templates

### 5.1 MiniMap + Controls
Add React Flow's `<MiniMap>`, `<Controls>`, `<Background>` to canvas.

### 5.2 Undo/Redo
**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useUndoRedo.ts`
- History stack of graph snapshots (max 50)
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcuts

### 5.3 Templates
**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/templates.ts`
- "HTTP Request Pipeline" - Trigger -> Tool -> Transform -> Output
- "Agent Pipeline" - Trigger -> Agent -> Tool -> Output
- "Conditional Routing" - Trigger -> Condition -> Tool A / Tool B -> Output
- "Data Processing Loop" - Trigger -> Tool (fetch list) -> Loop -> Tool (process) -> Output
- Template selector on create page

### 5.4 Runs Tab
Add Tabs component to workflow page: "Canvas" | "Runs"
- Runs tab: execution history table with status, duration, timestamp
- Click a run to overlay results on canvas

---

## File Summary (all phases)

### New Files (~35 files)
```
# Phase 1 - Data model & CRUD
apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/page.tsx
apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/new/page.tsx
apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/route.ts
apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/route.ts

# Phase 2 - Canvas
apps/web/src/app/dashboard/workflows/[id]/page.tsx
apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/graph/route.ts
apps/web/src/components/workflows/WorkflowCanvas.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/NodePalette.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/NodeInspector.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/WorkflowToolbar.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/TriggerNode.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/ToolNode.tsx

apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/ConditionNode.tsx

apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/TransformNode.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/OutputNode.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/NoteNode.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/edges/DataEdge.tsx

# Phase 3 - Node config
apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/ToolNodeInspector.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/AgentNodeInspector.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/ConditionNodeInspector.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/LoopNodeInspector.tsx

apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/OutputNodeInspector.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/SchemaFormGenerator.tsx
apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useUpstreamOutputs.ts

# Phase 4 - Execution
apps/web/src/lib/workflows/execute.ts
apps/web/src/lib/workflows/topological-sort.ts
```

### Modified Files
```
packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma          # New models + enums + User relation
apps/web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardLayout.tsx  # Sidebar nav entry
apps/web/package.json                     # @xyflow/react dependency
```

### Existing Code to Reuse
- `apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts` -> `executeWithExecutor()`, `resolveExecutorConfig()`, `parseExecutorConfig()`
- `apps/web/src/lib/agents/build-tools.ts` -> `buildAgentTools()` pattern for tool composition
- `apps/web/src/lib/ai-agent/tool-executor-agent.ts` -> `createToolDefinition()` for agent node execution
- `apps/web/src/lib/api-keys/middleware` -> `authenticateRequest()` for API auth
- All `@tpmjs/ui` components (no raw HTML, no barrel imports)

---

## Verification Plan

1. **Phase 1**: Visit `/dashboard/workflows`, verify empty state renders. Create a workflow, verify redirect to canvas page. Verify API routes return correct data.
2. **Phase 2**: Drag a tool from palette onto canvas. Connect two nodes. Verify auto-save fires and persists. Refresh page - graph should reload.
3. **Phase 3**: Select a tool node, verify form auto-generates from its `inputSchema`. Configure a data mapping. Verify inspector updates node config.
4. **Phase 4**: Create a simple Trigger -> Tool -> Output workflow. Click Run. Verify SSE stream shows node-by-node progress. Verify execution history shows in Runs tab.
5. **Full type-check**: `pnpm type-check` passes across all packages.
6. **Build**: `pnpm build` succeeds.


If you need specific details from before exiting plan mode (like exact code snippets, error messages, or content you generated), read the full transcript at: /Users/ajaxdavis/.REDACTED.jsonl

- **Tools section**: Loads from `/api/tools/search?q=...` with debounced search
- **Agents section**: Loads from `/api/agents` (user's agents)
- Each item is draggable (HTML5 drag API with `dataTransfer`)
- Compact list items showing icon + name + description

**`NodeInspector.tsx`** - right panel
- Renders when a node is selected
- Dispatches to type-specific inspector components
- Header with node type badge + label input
- Delete node button

**`WorkflowToolbar.tsx`** - top bar
- Save button with status indicator (Saved / Saving... / Unsaved)
- Run button (green, triggers execution)
- Status badge (DRAFT/ACTIVE)
- Workflow name (editable inline)
- Back button to workflows list

### 2.4 Custom Node Types

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/nodes/`

All nodes share consistent styling: rounded border, colored header bar by type, icon, label, handles.

| Node | Icon | Color | Handles | Special |
|------|------|-------|---------|---------|
| `TriggerNode` | `send` | blue | 1 output (bottom) | Shows trigger type badge |
| `ToolNode` | `puzzle` | purple | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows tool name + package |
| `AgentNode` | `terminal` | green | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows agent name + model |
| `ConditionNode` | `gitFork` | amber | 1 input (top), N outputs (bottom, labeled) | Diamond-ish shape |
| `LoopNode` | `loader` | teal | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows "Loop over..." |
| `TransformNode` | `edit` | slate | 1 input (top), 1 output (bottom) | Shows transform label |
| `OutputNode` | `check` | emerald | 1 input (top) | Rounded bottom |
| `NoteNode` | `message` | yellow | No handles | Resizable text area |

Each node includes a small status dot (for execution overlay) - grey by default, animated during runs.

### 2.5 Custom Edge

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/edges/DataEdge.tsx`

Bezier edge with:
- Default: solid line with subtle arrow
- During execution: animated dashes (CSS animation)
- Optional label showing data mapping preview

### 2.6 Graph Save API

**File**: `apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/graph/route.ts`

`PUT /api/workflows/[id]/graph` - bulk save:
- Accepts `{ nodes: [...], edges: [...], canvasViewport: {x,y,zoom} }`
- Prisma transaction: delete all existing nodes/edges, create new ones
- Validates ownership
- Increments `version`

This is the primary save endpoint. Auto-save debounces to 2s after any change.

---

## Phase 3: Node Configuration & Data Mapping

### 3.1 Inspector Components

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/inspectors/`

**`ToolNodeInspector.tsx`** - the star feature
- Fetches tool details (incl. `inputSchema`) from `/api/tools/[toolId]`
- Auto-generates form from JSON Schema using `SchemaFormGenerator`
- Each field has a toggle: "Static value" vs "Map from upstream"
- Static: renders appropriate input (Input, Select, Switch, Textarea based on type)
- Mapped: dropdown of available upstream outputs using `{{nodeId.output.path}}` syntax
- Shows tool description, package name, health status

**`AgentNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Dropdown to select agent (from `/api/agents`)
- Prompt template (Textarea, supports `{{input.field}}` interpolation)
- Shows agent model/provider as Badge

**`ConditionNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Field selector (from upstream outputs)
- Operator dropdown (`===`, `!==`, `>`, `<`, `includes`, `exists`)
- Value input
- "Add Branch" button for multi-way conditions
- Each branch auto-creates a new output handle on the node

**`LoopNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Array path selector (dropdown of upstream array outputs)
- Max iterations input (default 100, safety cap)

**`TransformNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Output field mapping: table of `fieldName -> expression`
- Add/remove field rows
- Expression uses `{{input.field}}` syntax

**`OutputNodeInspector.tsx`**
- Label input
- Optional output schema preview

### 3.2 Schema Form Generator

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/SchemaFormGenerator.tsx`

Reusable component that takes a JSON Schema and renders form fields:
- `string` -> `Input`
- `number` -> `Input[type=number]`
- `boolean` -> `Switch`
- `enum` -> `Select`
- `array` -> list with "Add Item" button
- `object` -> nested fieldset (recursive)
- Each field supports static value OR mapped expression toggle

### 3.3 Upstream Output Resolution

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useUpstreamOutputs.ts`

Given a node ID and the current graph, walks backward through edges to find all upstream nodes and their output schemas. Returns a structured list for data mapping dropdowns.

---

## Phase 4: Execution Engine

### 4.1 Core Engine

**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/execute.ts`

```ts
async function executeWorkflow(
  workflowId: string,
  triggerInput: Record<string, unknown>,
  userId: string,
  onNodeStatus: (nodeId: string, status, output?) => void
): Promise<WorkflowExecutionResult>
```

Algorithm:
1. Load workflow with nodes + edges
2. Build adjacency list
3. Topological sort (Kahn's algorithm) -> execution order
4. Group by level (same-level nodes = parallel)
5. For each level, execute all nodes with `Promise.all`:
   - Resolve inputs via data mapping from upstream outputs
   - Execute node based on type
   - Store output in context map
   - Fire `onNodeStatus` callback
6. Return final output from Output nodes

**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/topological-sort.ts` - Kahn's algorithm
**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/data-mapping.ts` - resolve `{{nodeId.output.path}}` templates

### 4.2 Node Executors

**Directory**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/node-executors/`

| Executor | What it does |
|----------|-------------|
| `trigger.ts` | Returns triggerInput as-is |
| `tool.ts` | Calls `executeWithExecutor()` from `lib/executors` - reuses the entire existing execution system |
| `agent.ts` | One-shot `generateText` call with agent config, similar to conversation route |
| `condition.ts` | Evaluates expression, returns `{ branch: 'true'/'false'/label }` |
| `loop.ts` | Iterates array, executing downstream subgraph per item |
| `transform.ts` | Applies field mapping |
| `output.ts` | Passes through input |

Key: Tool execution reuses `executeWithExecutor()` and `resolveExecutorConfig()` from `apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts`. Agent execution reuses `createToolDefinition()` and `buildAgentTools()` patterns.

### 4.3 Execution API

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/execute/route.ts`**
- POST: starts execution, streams SSE progress events
- `export const maxDuration = 300` (5 min)
- SSE events: `node_start`, `node_complete`, `node_error`, `workflow_complete`, `workflow_error`

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/executions/route.ts`**
- GET: paginated execution history

**`apps/web/src/app/api/workflows/[id]/executions/[executionId]/route.ts`**
- GET: single execution with all node results

### 4.4 Execution Overlay

**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useWorkflowExecution.ts`

React hook that:
- Opens EventSource to `/api/workflows/[id]/execute`
- Maintains `nodeStatuses: Map<nodeId, {status, output, duration}>`
- Returns `{ isRunning, nodeStatuses, runWorkflow, lastExecution }`

The node components read from this to show status indicators (blue pulse = running, green check = done, red X = failed).

---

## Phase 5: Polish & Templates

### 5.1 MiniMap + Controls
Add React Flow's `<MiniMap>`, `<Controls>`, `<Background>` to canvas.

### 5.2 Undo/Redo
**File**: `apps/web/src/components/workflows/hooks/useUndoRedo.ts`
- History stack of graph snapshots (max 50)
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcuts

### 5.3 Templates
**File**: `apps/web/src/lib/workflows/templates.ts`
- "HTTP Request Pipeline" - Trigger -> Tool -> Transform -> Output
- "Agent Pipeline" - Trigger -> Agent -> Tool -> Output
- "Conditional Routing" - Trigger -> Condition -> Tool A / Tool B -> Output
- "Data Processing Loop" - Trigger -> Tool (fetch list) -> Loop -> Tool (process) -> Output
- Template selector on create page

### 5.4 Runs Tab
Add Tabs component to workflow page: "Canvas" | "Runs"
- Runs tab: execution history table with status, duration, timestamp
- Click a run to overlay results on canvas

1→// This is your Prisma schema file,

     3→
     4→generator client {
     5→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     6→}
     7→
     8→datasource db {
     9→  provider  = "postgresql"
    10→  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
    11→  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {
    16→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    17→
    18→  // NPM Metadata
    19→  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
    20→  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
    21→  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
    23→  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
    24→  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
    25→  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
    26→  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
    27→  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
    28→  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
    29→  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB
    30→
    31→  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
    32→  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
    33→  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
    34→  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
    35→  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
    36→  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
    37→  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")
    38→

  1778→  showDebugMode      Boolean  @default(false) @map("show_debug_mode")
  1779→
  1780→  // Timestamps
  1781→  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1782→  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1783→
  1784→  @@map("omega_user_settings")
  1785→}
  1786→
  1787→// ============================================================================
  1788→// RealSkills Models (Living Skills Endpoint - Question-Driven Evolution)
  1789→// ============================================================================
  1790→
  1791→/// SkillQuestion - Agent questions stored with embeddings for RAG
  1792→model SkillQuestion {
  1793→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1794→
  1795→  // Collection relationship
  1796→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1797→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1798→
  1799→  // Question content
  1800→  question     String     @db.Text
  1801→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1802→
  1803→  // Response
  1804→  answer       String     @db.Text
  1805→  answerTokens Int        @default(0) @map("answer_tokens")
  1806→
  1807→  // Agent identity (anonymized in UI)
  1808→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64) // Hash of IP + user-agent for deduplication
  1809→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100) // Self-reported agent name
  1810→  sessionId    String?    @map("session_id") // Optional session for multi-turn
  1811→
  1812→  // Metadata
  1813→  tags         String[]   @default([]) @db.Text
  1814→  confidence   Float      @default(0)
  1815→  similarCount Int        @default(0) @map("similar_count") // Times similar question asked
  1816→
  1817→  // Graph relationships
  1818→  skillNodes   SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1819→  toolNodes    SkillQuestionTool[]
  1820→
  1821→  // Timestamps
  1822→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1823→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1824→
  1825→  @@index([collectionId])
  1826→  @@index([sessionId])
  1827→  @@index([createdAt])
  1828→  @@map("skill_questions")
  1829→}
  1830→
  1831→/// Skill - Emergent skill nodes identified from question patterns
  1832→model Skill {
  1833→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1834→
  1835→  // Collection relationship
  1836→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1837→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1838→
  1839→  // Skill identity
  1840→  name         String     @db.VarChar(200) // e.g., "React useEffect debugging"
  1841→  slug         String     @db.VarChar(200) // URL-safe version
  1842→  description  String     @db.Text
  1843→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1844→
  1845→  // Stats
  1846→  questionCount Int       @default(0) @map("question_count")
  1847→  confidence    Float     @default(0) // Aggregate confidence
  1848→
  1849→  // Graph relationships
  1850→  questions     SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1851→  parentSkill   Skill?    @relation("SkillHierarchy", fields: [parentSkillId], references: [id])
  1852→  parentSkillId String?   @map("parent_skill_id")
  1853→  childSkills   Skill[]   @relation("SkillHierarchy")
  1854→
  1855→  // Timestamps
  1856→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1857→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1858→
  1859→  @@unique([collectionId, slug])
  1860→  @@index([collectionId])
  1861→  @@index([questionCount])
  1862→  @@map("skills")
  1863→}
  1864→
  1865→/// SkillQuestionSkill - Junction table linking questions to skills
  1866→model SkillQuestionSkill {
  1867→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1868→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1869→  skillId    String        @map("skill_id")
  1870→  skill      Skill         @relation(fields: [skillId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1871→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1872→
  1873→  @@id([questionId, skillId])
  1874→  @@index([questionId])
  1875→  @@index([skillId])
  1876→  @@map("skill_question_skills")
  1877→}
  1878→
  1879→/// SkillQuestionTool - Junction table linking questions to tools mentioned
  1880→model SkillQuestionTool {
  1881→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1882→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1883→  toolId     String        @map("tool_id")
  1884→  tool       Tool          @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1885→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1886→
  1887→  @@id([questionId, toolId])
  1888→  @@index([questionId])
  1889→  @@index([toolId])
  1890→  @@map("skill_question_tools")
  1891→}
  1892→
  1893→/// SkillSession - Optional multi-turn conversation sessions
  1894→model SkillSession {
  1895→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1896→
  1897→  // Collection relationship
  1898→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1899→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1900→
  1901→  // Session state
  1902→  context      Json       @default("[]") @db.JsonB // Message history
  1903→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  1904→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1905→
  1906→  // Timestamps
  1907→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1908→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1909→  expiresAt    DateTime   @map("expires_at") // Auto-expire sessions
  1910→
  1911→  @@index([collectionId])
  1912→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1913→  @@map("skill_sessions")
  1914→}
  1915→
  1916→// ============================================================================
  1917→// Memory Models (Persistent Semantic Memory for AI Tool Collections)
  1918→// ============================================================================
  1919→
  1920→/// Memory - user-owned persistent memories for AI agents
  1921→model Memory {
  1922→  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  1923→
  1924→  // Owner relationship
  1925→  userId           String    @map("user_id")
  1926→  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1927→
  1928→  // Content
  1929→  content          Json      @db.JsonB // Arbitrary JSON payload
  1930→  summary          String    @db.VarChar(500) // Auto-generated or user-provided preview
  1931→  namespace        String?   @db.VarChar(100) // Grouping like "project-x", "personal"
  1932→  tags             String[]  @default([]) @db.Text // Categorization tags
  1933→
  1934→  // Embedding for semantic search
  1935→  embedding        Json      @db.JsonB // 3072-dim float array (text-embedding-3-large)
  1936→
  1937→  // Provenance tracking
  1938→  source           String    @db.VarChar(100) // Which tool created it ("createMemoryTool", "dashboard")
  1939→  sourceAgent      String?   @map("source_agent") @db.VarChar(200) // Agent name/identifier
  1940→  sourceContext    Json?     @map("source_context") @db.JsonB // Additional creation context
  1941→
  1942→  // Size tracking
  1943→  contentSizeBytes Int       @map("content_size_bytes")
  1944→
  1945→  // TTL support
  1946→  expiresAt        DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  1947→
  1948→  // Timestamps
  1949→  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1950→  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1951→
  1952→  @@index([userId])
  1953→  @@index([userId, namespace])
  1954→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  1955→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1956→  @@map("memories")
  1957→}
  1958→
  1959→// ============================================================================
  1960→// Execution Event Tracking (Unified per-tool execution tracking)
  1961→// ============================================================================
  1962→
  1963→/// ExecutionEvent - unified tracking for tool calls, agent runs, collection use, and scenario runs
  1964→model ExecutionEvent {
  1965→  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  1966→
  1967→  // Event classification
  1968→  eventType String @map("event_type") @db.VarChar(30) // 'tool_call' | 'agent_run' | 'collection_use' | 'scenario_run'
  1969→  source    String @db.VarChar(30) // 'mcp_http' | 'mcp_sse' | 'agent_chat' | 'ui_simulation' | 'scenario' | 'omega'
  1970→
  1971→  // Actor (no FK constraints - tracking must never fail due to entity deletion)
  1972→  userId   String? @map("user_id")
  1973→  apiKeyId String? @map("api_key_id")
  1974→
  1975→  // Entity references (no FK constraints for resilience)
  1976→  toolId       String? @map("tool_id")
  1977→  agentId      String? @map("agent_id")
  1978→  collectionId String? @map("collection_id")
  1979→
  1980→  // Denormalized for fast queries without joins
  1981→  toolName    String? @map("tool_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  1982→  packageName String? @map("package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
  1983→
  1984→  // Outcome
  1985→  status     String  @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'timeout'
  1986→  durationMs Int?    @map("duration_ms")
  1987→
  1988→  // Token usage (for agent runs)
  1989→  tokensIn  Int? @map("tokens_in")
  1990→  tokensOut Int? @map("tokens_out")
  1991→
  1992→  // Error details
  1993→  errorCode    String? @map("error_code") @db.VarChar(50)
  1994→  errorMessage String? @map("error_message") @db.Text
  1995→
  1996→  // Timestamps
  1997→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1998→
  1999→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  2000→  @@index([collectionId, createdAt])
  2001→  @@index([toolId, createdAt])
  2002→  @@index([eventType, createdAt])
  2003→  @@index([createdAt])
  2004→  @@map("execution_events")
  2005→}
  2006→
  2007→// ============================================================================
  2008→// Search Log (Query Tracking)
  2009→// ============================================================================
  2010→
  2011→/// SearchLog - tracks search queries, result counts, and latency
  2012→model SearchLog {
  2013→  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  2014→
  2015→  // Search data
  2016→  query       String   @db.VarChar(500)
  2017→  resultCount Int      @map("result_count")
  2018→  latencyMs   Int      @map("latency_ms")
  2019→
  2020→  // Optional actor
  2021→  userId      String?  @map("user_id")
  2022→  sessionId   String?  @map("session_id")
  2023→
  2024→  // Timestamps
  2025→  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  2026→
  2027→  @@index([createdAt])
  2028→  @@index([query])
  2029→  @@map("search_logs")
  2030→}
  2031→

Perfect. Now let me compile the complete codebase exploration report:

---

## TPMJS Codebase Exploration Report

I've thoroughly analyzed the TPMJS codebase to provide you with all the patterns and structures you need for implementing a workflow builder. Here's the complete reference:

### 1. PRISMA SCHEMA STRUCTURE (`packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma`)

**Key Models for Reference:**

- **Agent Model** (lines 608-680): Stores AI agent configurations with:
  - `id`, `userId`, `uid` (URL-friendly identifier)
  - `name`, `description`, provider/modelId configuration
  - Relations: `collections` (AgentCollection), `tools` (AgentTool), `conversations`
  - Timestamps: `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
  - Execution config: `executorType`, `executorConfig` (JSON), `sandboxEnabled`

- **Collection Model** (lines 484-558): User-created groups of tools:
  - `id`, `userId`, `name`, `slug`, `description`, `isPublic`
  - Fork tracking: `forkedFromId`, `forkedFrom`, `forks`, `forkCount`
  - Executor config: `executorType`, `executorConfig`, `envVars` (encrypted JSON)
  - Relations: `tools` (CollectionTool), `agents` (AgentCollection), `customTools` (CollectionCustomTool)

- **ActivityType Enum** (lines 935-967): 
  ```
  AGENT_CREATED, AGENT_UPDATED, AGENT_DELETED, AGENT_CLONED, AGENT_FORKED,
  AGENT_TOOL_ADDED, AGENT_TOOL_REMOVED, AGENT_COLLECTION_ADDED, AGENT_COLLECTION_REMOVED,
  COLLECTION_CREATED, COLLECTION_UPDATED, COLLECTION_DELETED, COLLECTION_CLONED, COLLECTION_FORKED,
  COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED, COLLECTION_TOOL_REMOVED,
  TOOL_LIKED, TOOL_UNLIKED, COLLECTION_LIKED, COLLECTION_UNLIKED, AGENT_LIKED, AGENT_UNLIKED,
  COLLECTION_TOOLS_BULK_ADDED, API_KEY_CREATED, API_KEY_DELETED,
  COLLECTION_ENV_UPDATED, AGENT_CONFIG_UPDATED, BRIDGE_CONNECTED, BRIDGE_DISCONNECTED,
  TOOL_EXECUTED, AGENT_CONVERSATION_STARTED
  ```

- **UserActivity Model** (lines 970-1000): Activity stream tracking:
  - `id`, `userId`, `type` (ActivityType), `agentId`, `collectionId`, `toolId`
  - Denormalized fields: `targetName`, `targetType`, `metadata` (JSON)
  - Index: `[userId, createdAt]` for efficient activity feeds

**Pattern: Cascade JSON Storage**
- `executorConfig`, `envVars`, and other flexible configs stored as JSON
- Always include `null` checks and type casting when reading

---

### 2. DASHBOARD LAYOUT (`apps/web/src/components/dashboard/DashboardLayout.tsx`)

**Props Interface:**
```typescript
interface DashboardLayoutProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;           // Required: header title
  subtitle?: string;       // Optional: description
  actions?: React.ReactNode;  // Action buttons (right side)
  showBackButton?: boolean;
  backUrl?: string;
  fullHeight?: boolean;    // For chat/terminal interfaces
}
```

**Navigation Structure:**
- Main sections: Overview, Activity, Agents, Collections, Memories
- Settings section: Profile, AI Provider Keys, Platform API Keys, Bridge, Usage
- Admin section: Only shows for admin users (checked via `/api/admin/stats`)
- Likes section: Collapsible with localStorage persistence

**Key Features:**
- Responsive sidebar (sticky on desktop, fixed on mobile)
- Auto-closes sidebar on route change
- Uses `usePathname()` and `useRouter()` for navigation
- Session check redirects to `/sign-in` if not authenticated
- Mobile menu button with backdrop overlay

**Navigation items use icons:** `home`, `barChart`, `terminal`, `folder`, `database`, `user`, `puzzle`, `key`, `link`, `globe`, `heart`

---

### 3. AGENTS PAGE PATTERN (`apps/web/src/app/dashboard/agents/page.tsx`)

**Component Structure:**
```typescript
interface Agent {
  id: string;
  uid: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  provider: AIProvider;
  modelId: string;
  toolCount: number;
  collectionCount: number;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
```

**Data Fetching:**
- `GET /api/agents` with pagination: `?limit=20&offset=0`
- Loading state: 3-skeleton placeholders while fetching
- Empty state: Icon + title + description + action button
- Error state: Alert icon + error message + retry button

**Table Structure:**
- Columns: Name (icon + title + description), Provider, Tools, Updated, Actions
- Interactive rows: Click to navigate to detail page
- Actions: Chat button + Delete button

**Patterns:**
- `formatDate()` utility for consistent date formatting
- Provider display names and color mapping (`AIProvider → Badge color`)
- Confirmation dialog before deletion with error handling

---

### 4. CREATE PAGE PATTERN (`apps/web/src/app/dashboard/agents/new/page.tsx`)

**Form Structure:**
```typescript
interface FormData {
  name: string;                    // Max 100 chars
  uid: string;                     // URL-friendly, auto-generated
  description: string;             // Max 500 chars
  provider: AIProvider;
  modelId: string;
  systemPrompt: string;            // Max 10000 chars
  temperature: number;             // 0-2
  maxToolCallsPerTurn: number;      // 1-100
  maxMessagesInContext: number;    // 1-100
}
```

**Form Sections:**
1. **Basic Information:** Name, UID (auto-generated), Description
2. **Model Configuration:** Provider, Model, System Prompt, Temperature, Max Tool Calls, Context Messages
3. **Info banner:** Explains tools are added after creation
4. **Error handling:** Red alert box with error message

**Auto-generation Logic:**
- UID auto-generates from name: lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens
- UID updates automatically as name changes (unless manually edited)
- Model resets when provider changes

**Form Actions:**
- Page layout: No DashboardLayout wrapper, uses AppHeader directly
- Back navigation via arrow link to parent
- Submit button: Shows loading state "Creating..." while submitting

---

### 5. AGENTS API ROUTE (`apps/web/src/app/api/agents/route.ts`)

**Exports Required:**
```typescript
export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration = 60;  // Critical for Vercel
```

**GET Handler:**
- Calls `authenticateRequest()` to check auth
- Returns 401 if not authenticated or userId missing
- Query params: `limit` (max 50), `offset` (for pagination)
- Uses `take: limit + 1` for hasMore pagination (avoids `count()`)
- Returns: `{ success, data, pagination: { limit, offset, count, hasMore } }`

**POST Handler:**
- Validates body with schema: `CreateAgentSchema.safeParse(body)`
- Checks agent count against `AGENT_LIMITS.MAX_AGENTS_PER_USER`
- Auto-generates UID if not provided, appends random suffix if collision
- Checks name uniqueness per user
- Transaction wraps creation + auto-like
- Logs activity via `logActivity()` (fire-and-forget)
- Returns: `{ success, data, ... }` with status 201

**Pattern for List Response:**
```typescript
data.map((a) => ({
  ...a,
  toolCount: a._count.tools,
  collectionCount: a._count.collections,
  _count: undefined,  // Strip internal _count
}))
```

---

### 6. AUTHENTICATION MIDDLEWARE (`apps/web/src/lib/api-keys/middleware.ts`)

**authenticateRequest() Function:**
```typescript
interface AuthResult {
  authenticated: boolean;
  userId?: string;
  apiKeyId?: string;
  scopes?: string[];
  tier?: UserTier;
  error?: string;
  isSessionAuth?: boolean;
}

export async function authenticateRequest(): Promise<AuthResult>
```

**Authentication Cascade:**
1. Try session auth first: `await auth.api.getSession({ headers: await headers() })`
2. If no session, try API key auth: parse `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header
3. Validates key format: `tpmjs_sk_*`
4. Hashes key and looks up in database
5. Checks: `isActive`, `expiresAt`
6. Updates `lastUsedAt` (fire-and-forget)

**Usage Pattern in API routes:**
```typescript
const authResult = await authenticateRequest();
if (!authResult.authenticated || !authResult.userId) {
  return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
}

const userId = authResult.userId;
// ... rest of logic
```

**Helper Functions:**
- `hasScope(authResult, scope)`: Check if auth has scope
- `requireAuth(scope?)`: Returns `{ auth, errorResponse }` tuple

---

### 7. EXECUTORS SYSTEM (`apps/web/src/lib/executors/index.ts`)

**Executor Resolution Cascade:**
```
Agent Config → Collection Config → System Default
```

**ExecutorConfig Types:**
```typescript
type ExecutorConfig = 
  | { type: 'default' }
  | { type: 'custom_url', url: string, apiKey?: string }
```

**Key Functions:**

- `resolveExecutorConfig(agentConfig, collectionConfig)`: Returns resolved config
- `parseExecutorConfig(executorType, executorConfig)`: Safely parse from DB JSON
- `executeWithExecutor(config, request)`: Execute tool with resolved executor
- `getSandboxConfig()`: Read `AGENT_SANDBOX_URL`, `AGENT_SANDBOX_API_KEY` env vars

**Sandbox Session Management:**
- `createSandboxSession(url, apiKey, sessionId, timeoutSeconds)`: Create/resume session
- `destroySandboxSession(url, apiKey, sessionId)`: Cleanup (fire-and-forget safe)
- `executeWithSandbox(url, apiKey, request, sessionId)`: Execute with sandbox

**Session ID Format:**
```
agentId:conversationId
```
- TTL: 24 hours inactivity (extended on each tool call)
- After expiry: workspace deleted, next message starts fresh

**Error Handling:**
- Retry logic with exponential backoff (2 retries)
- Retries on: timeouts, 429, 502, 503, network errors
- Base delay: 1000ms × 2^attempt

---

### 8. @tpmjs/UI COMPONENTS AVAILABLE

**Complete Component List:**
- **Layout:** `Container`, `GridContainer`, `Section`
- **Forms:** `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `Label`, `FormField`, `Switch`, `Slider`
- **Navigation:** `Tabs`, `Breadcrumbs`, `Pagination`, `DropdownMenu`
- **Displays:** `Badge`, `Table` (with `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableCell`, `TableHead`, `TableEmpty`), `Card`, `StatCard`, `ToolCard`
- **Feedback:** `Toast`, `Modal`, `Drawer`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `ErrorState`, `EmptyState`, `LoadingState`, `ProgressBar`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`
- **Interactive:** `Button`, `Icon` (with icon names), `Accordion`
- **Special:** `CodeBlock`, `InstallSnippet`, `ActivityStream`, `AnimatedCounter`, `DitherCanvas`, `DitherText`, `FlowDiagram`, `ToolHealthBadge`, `ToolHealthBanner`, `ToolRenderer`

**Import Pattern:**
```typescript
// CORRECT - Direct imports, no barrel exports
import { Button } from '@tpmjs/ui/Button/Button';
import { Icon } from '@tpmjs/ui/Icon/Icon';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableEmpty, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@tpmjs/ui/Table/Table';

// WRONG - Don't use barrel exports
// import { Button } from '@tpmjs/ui';  ✗ FORBIDDEN
```

---

### 9. PACKAGE.JSON DEPENDENCIES (`apps/web/package.json`)

**Key Dependencies:**
- **Next.js:** `16.1.1` (App Router)
- **React:** `19.2.3`
- **UI/Styling:** Tailwind CSS (via `@tpmjs/tailwind-config`)
- **Database:** `@prisma/client` `6.19.1`

  1657→  executionState    String   @default("idle") @map("execution_state") @db.VarChar(20) // idle, running, paused, cancelled
  1658→
  1659→  // Token tracking (aggregate across all messages)
  1660→  inputTokensTotal  Int      @default(0) @map("input_tokens_total")
  1661→  outputTokensTotal Int      @default(0) @map("output_tokens_total")
  1662→
  1663→  // Timestamps
  1664→  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1665→  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1666→
  1667→  // Relations
  1668→  messages          OmegaMessage[]
  1669→  participants      OmegaParticipant[]
  1670→  toolRuns          OmegaToolRun[]
  1671→
  1672→  @@index([ownerId])
  1673→  @@index([createdAt])
  1674→  @@map("omega_conversations")
  1675→}
  1676→
  1677→/// OmegaMessage - individual message in an Omega conversation
  1678→model OmegaMessage {
  1679→  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  1680→
  1681→  // Conversation relationship
  1682→  conversationId String   @map("conversation_id")
  1683→  conversation   OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1684→
  1685→  // Message content
  1686→  role           MessageRole
  1687→  content        String   @db.Text
  1688→
  1689→  // Author info (for multi-user conversations)
  1690→  authorId       String?  @map("author_id")
  1691→  authorEmail    String?  @map("author_email")
  1692→  authorName     String?  @map("author_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1693→
  1694→  // Tool calls (for ASSISTANT messages)
  1695→  toolCalls      Json?    @map("tool_calls") @db.JsonB
  1696→
  1697→  // Token tracking
  1698→  inputTokens    Int?     @map("input_tokens")
  1699→  outputTokens   Int?     @map("output_tokens")
  1700→
  1701→  // Timestamps
  1702→  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1703→
  1704→  @@index([conversationId])
  1705→  @@index([createdAt])
  1706→  @@map("omega_messages")
  1707→}
  1708→
  1709→/// OmegaParticipant - tracks users in an Omega conversation
  1710→model OmegaParticipant {
  1711→  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  1712→
  1713→  // Conversation relationship
  1714→  conversationId String   @map("conversation_id")
  1715→  conversation   OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1716→
  1717→  // User info
  1718→  userId         String?  @map("user_id")
  1719→  displayName    String   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1720→  email          String?
  1721→
  1722→  // Role in conversation
  1723→  role           String   @default("collaborator") @db.VarChar(20) // owner, collaborator
  1724→
  1725→  // Timestamps
  1726→  joinedAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("joined_at")
  1727→
  1728→  @@unique([conversationId, userId])
  1729→  @@index([conversationId])
  1730→  @@map("omega_participants")
  1731→}
  1732→
  1733→/// OmegaToolRun - tracks tool executions within Omega conversations
  1734→model OmegaToolRun {
  1735→  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  1736→
  1737→  // Conversation relationship
  1738→  conversationId  String    @map("conversation_id")
  1739→  conversation    OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1740→
  1741→  // Message relationship (optional - for linking to specific message)
  1742→  messageId       String?   @map("message_id")
  1743→
  1744→  // Tool execution details
  1745→  toolName        String    @map("tool_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  1746→  input           Json      @db.JsonB
  1747→  output          Json?     @db.JsonB
  1748→  error           String?   @db.Text
  1749→
  1750→  // Status tracking
  1751→  status          String    @db.VarChar(20) // pending, running, success, error
  1752→
  1753→  // Timing
  1754→  startedAt       DateTime  @default(now()) @map("started_at")
  1755→  completedAt     DateTime? @map("completed_at")
  1756→  executionTimeMs Int?      @map("execution_time_ms")
  1757→
  1758→  @@index([conversationId])
  1759→  @@index([status])
  1760→  @@map("omega_tool_runs")
  1761→}
  1762→
  1763→/// OmegaUserSettings - user preferences for Omega
  1764→model OmegaUserSettings {
  1765→  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  1766→
  1767→  // User relationship
  1768→  userId             String   @unique @map("user_id")
  1769→
  1770→  // Tool preferences
  1771→  pinnedToolIds      String[] @default([]) @map("pinned_tool_ids")
  1772→  blockedToolIds     String[] @default([]) @map("blocked_tool_ids")
  1773→
  1774→  // Customization
  1775→  customSystemPrompt String?  @map("custom_system_prompt") @db.Text
  1776→
  1777→  // UI preferences
  1778→  showDebugMode      Boolean  @default(false) @map("show_debug_mode")
  1779→
  1780→  // Timestamps
  1781→  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1782→  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1783→
  1784→  @@map("omega_user_settings")
  1785→}
  1786→
  1787→// ============================================================================
  1788→// RealSkills Models (Living Skills Endpoint - Question-Driven Evolution)
  1789→// ============================================================================
  1790→
  1791→/// SkillQuestion - Agent questions stored with embeddings for RAG
  1792→model SkillQuestion {
  1793→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1794→
  1795→  // Collection relationship
  1796→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1797→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1798→
  1799→  // Question content
  1800→  question     String     @db.Text
  1801→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1802→
  1803→  // Response
  1804→  answer       String     @db.Text
  1805→  answerTokens Int        @default(0) @map("answer_tokens")
  1806→
  1807→  // Agent identity (anonymized in UI)
  1808→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64) // Hash of IP + user-agent for deduplication
  1809→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100) // Self-reported agent name
  1810→  sessionId    String?    @map("session_id") // Optional session for multi-turn
  1811→
  1812→  // Metadata
  1813→  tags         String[]   @default([]) @db.Text
  1814→  confidence   Float      @default(0)
  1815→  similarCount Int        @default(0) @map("similar_count") // Times similar question asked
  1816→
  1817→  // Graph relationships
  1818→  skillNodes   SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1819→  toolNodes    SkillQuestionTool[]
  1820→
  1821→  // Timestamps
  1822→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1823→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1824→
  1825→  @@index([collectionId])
  1826→  @@index([sessionId])
  1827→  @@index([createdAt])
  1828→  @@map("skill_questions")
  1829→}
  1830→
  1831→/// Skill - Emergent skill nodes identified from question patterns
  1832→model Skill {
  1833→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1834→
  1835→  // Collection relationship
  1836→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1837→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1838→
  1839→  // Skill identity
  1840→  name         String     @db.VarChar(200) // e.g., "React useEffect debugging"
  1841→  slug         String     @db.VarChar(200) // URL-safe version
  1842→  description  String     @db.Text
  1843→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1844→
  1845→  // Stats
  1846→  questionCount Int       @default(0) @map("question_count")
  1847→  confidence    Float     @default(0) // Aggregate confidence
  1848→
  1849→  // Graph relationships
  1850→  questions     SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1851→  parentSkill   Skill?    @relation("SkillHierarchy", fields: [parentSkillId], references: [id])
  1852→  parentSkillId String?   @map("parent_skill_id")
  1853→  childSkills   Skill[]   @relation("SkillHierarchy")
  1854→
  1855→  // Timestamps
  1856→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1857→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1858→
  1859→  @@unique([collectionId, slug])
  1860→  @@index([collectionId])
  1861→  @@index([questionCount])
  1862→  @@map("skills")
  1863→}
  1864→
  1865→/// SkillQuestionSkill - Junction table linking questions to skills
  1866→model SkillQuestionSkill {
  1867→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1868→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1869→  skillId    String        @map("skill_id")
  1870→  skill      Skill         @relation(fields: [skillId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1871→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1872→
  1873→  @@id([questionId, skillId])
  1874→  @@index([questionId])
  1875→  @@index([skillId])
  1876→  @@map("skill_question_skills")
  1877→}
  1878→
  1879→/// SkillQuestionTool - Junction table linking questions to tools mentioned
  1880→model SkillQuestionTool {
  1881→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1882→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1883→  toolId     String        @map("tool_id")
  1884→  tool       Tool          @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1885→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1886→
  1887→  @@id([questionId, toolId])
  1888→  @@index([questionId])
  1889→  @@index([toolId])
  1890→  @@map("skill_question_tools")
  1891→}
  1892→
  1893→/// SkillSession - Optional multi-turn conversation sessions
  1894→model SkillSession {
  1895→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1896→
  1897→  // Collection relationship
  1898→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1899→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1900→
  1901→  // Session state
  1902→  context      Json       @default("[]") @db.JsonB // Message history
  1903→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  1904→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1905→
  1906→  // Timestamps
  1907→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1908→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1909→  expiresAt    DateTime   @map("expires_at") // Auto-expire sessions
  1910→
  1911→  @@index([collectionId])
  1912→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1913→  @@map("skill_sessions")
  1914→}
  1915→
  1916→// ============================================================================
  1917→// Memory Models (Persistent Semantic Memory for AI Tool Collections)
  1918→// ============================================================================
  1919→
  1920→/// Memory - user-owned persistent memories for AI agents
  1921→model Memory {
  1922→  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  1923→
  1924→  // Owner relationship
  1925→  userId           String    @map("user_id")
  1926→  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1927→
  1928→  // Content
  1929→  content          Json      @db.JsonB // Arbitrary JSON payload
  1930→  summary          String    @db.VarChar(500) // Auto-generated or user-provided preview
  1931→  namespace        String?   @db.VarChar(100) // Grouping like "project-x", "personal"
  1932→  tags             String[]  @default([]) @db.Text // Categorization tags
  1933→
  1934→  // Embedding for semantic search
  1935→  embedding        Json      @db.JsonB // 3072-dim float array (text-embedding-3-large)
  1936→
  1937→  // Provenance tracking
  1938→  source           String    @db.VarChar(100) // Which tool created it ("createMemoryTool", "dashboard")
  1939→  sourceAgent      String?   @map("source_agent") @db.VarChar(200) // Agent name/identifier
  1940→  sourceContext    Json?     @map("source_context") @db.JsonB // Additional creation context
  1941→
  1942→  // Size tracking
  1943→  contentSizeBytes Int       @map("content_size_bytes")
  1944→
  1945→  // TTL support
  1946→  expiresAt        DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  1947→
  1948→  // Timestamps
  1949→  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1950→  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1951→
  1952→  @@index([userId])
  1953→  @@index([userId, namespace])
  1954→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  1955→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1956→  @@map("memories")
  1957→}
  1958→
  1959→// ============================================================================
  1960→// Execution Event Tracking (Unified per-tool execution tracking)
  1961→// ============================================================================
  1962→
  1963→/// ExecutionEvent - unified tracking for tool calls, agent runs, collection use, and scenario runs
  1964→model ExecutionEvent {
  1965→  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  1966→
  1967→  // Event classification
  1968→  eventType String @map("event_type") @db.VarChar(30) // 'tool_call' | 'agent_run' | 'collection_use' | 'scenario_run'
  1969→  source    String @db.VarChar(30) // 'mcp_http' | 'mcp_sse' | 'agent_chat' | 'ui_simulation' | 'scenario' | 'omega'
  1970→
  1971→  // Actor (no FK constraints - tracking must never fail due to entity deletion)
  1972→  userId   String? @map("user_id")
  1973→  apiKeyId String? @map("api_key_id")
  1974→
  1975→  // Entity references (no FK constraints for resilience)
  1976→  toolId       String? @map("tool_id")
  1977→  agentId      String? @map("agent_id")
  1978→  collectionId String? @map("collection_id")
  1979→
  1980→  // Denormalized for fast queries without joins
  1981→  toolName    String? @map("tool_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  1982→  packageName String? @map("package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
  1983→
  1984→  // Outcome
  1985→  status     String  @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'timeout'
  1986→  durationMs Int?    @map("duration_ms")
  1987→
  1988→  // Token usage (for agent runs)
  1989→  tokensIn  Int? @map("tokens_in")
  1990→  tokensOut Int? @map("tokens_out")
  1991→
  1992→  // Error details
  1993→  errorCode    String? @map("error_code") @db.VarChar(50)
  1994→  errorMessage String? @map("error_message") @db.Text
  1995→
  1996→  // Timestamps
  1997→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1998→
  1999→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  2000→  @@index([collectionId, createdAt])
  2001→  @@index([toolId, createdAt])
  2002→  @@index([eventType, createdAt])
  2003→  @@index([createdAt])
  2004→  @@map("execution_events")
  2005→}
  2006→
  2007→// ============================================================================
  2008→// Search Log (Query Tracking)
  2009→// ============================================================================
  2010→
  2011→/// SearchLog - tracks search queries, result counts, and latency
  2012→model SearchLog {
  2013→  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  2014→
  2015→  // Search data
  2016→  query       String   @db.VarChar(500)
  2017→  resultCount Int      @map("result_count")
  2018→  latencyMs   Int      @map("latency_ms")
  2019→
  2020→  // Optional actor
  2021→  userId      String?  @map("user_id")
  2022→  sessionId   String?  @map("session_id")
  2023→
  2024→  // Timestamps
  2025→  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  2026→
  2027→  @@index([createdAt])
  2028→  @@index([query])
  2029→  @@map("search_logs")
  2030→}
  2031→

1→import type { ActivityType, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
     2→import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';
     3→
     4→export interface LogActivityParams {
     5→  userId: string;
     6→  type: ActivityType;
     7→  targetName: string;
     8→  targetType: 'agent' | 'collection' | 'tool' | 'api_key' | 'bridge';
     9→  agentId?: string;
    10→  collectionId?: string;
    11→  toolId?: string;
    12→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Log user activity (fire-and-forget pattern)
    17→ * Never throws - failures are logged but don't break the main operation
    18→ */
    19→export async function logActivity(params: LogActivityParams): Promise<void> {
    20→  try {
    21→    await prisma.userActivity.create({
    22→      data: {
    23→        userId: params.userId,
    24→        type: params.type,
    25→        targetName: params.targetName,
    26→        targetType: params.targetType,
    27→        agentId: params.agentId,
    28→        collectionId: params.collectionId,
    29→        toolId: params.toolId,
    30→        metadata: params.metadata as Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined,
    31→      },
    32→    });
    33→  } catch (error) {
    34→    // Never throw - activity logging should never break main operations
    35→    console.error('Failed to log activity:', error);
    36→  }
    37→}
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Activity type to human-readable message mapping
    41→ */
    42→export const ACTIVITY_MESSAGES: Record<
    43→  ActivityType,
    44→  (targetName: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) => string
    45→> = {
    46→  AGENT_CREATED: (name) => `Created agent "${name}"`,
    47→  AGENT_UPDATED: (name) => `Updated agent "${name}"`,
    48→  AGENT_DELETED: (name) => `Deleted agent "${name}"`,
    49→  AGENT_CLONED: (name) => `Cloned agent "${name}"`,
    50→  AGENT_FORKED: (name, meta) =>
    51→    meta?.sourceAgentName
    52→      ? `Forked agent "${meta.sourceAgentName}" as "${name}"`
    53→      : `Forked agent as "${name}"`,
    54→  AGENT_TOOL_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    55→    meta?.toolName
    56→      ? `Added tool "${meta.toolName}" to agent "${name}"`

import type { ActivityType, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';

export interface LogActivityParams {
  userId: string;
  type: ActivityType;
  targetName: string;
  targetType: 'agent' | 'collection' | 'tool' | 'api_key' | 'bridge';
  agentId?: string;
  collectionId?: string;
  toolId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * Log user activity (fire-and-forget pattern)
 * Never throws - failures are logged but don't break the main operation
 */
export async function logActivity(params: LogActivityParams): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await prisma.userActivity.create({
      data: {
        userId: params.userId,
        type: params.type,
        targetName: params.targetName,
        targetType: params.targetType,
        agentId: params.agentId,
        collectionId: params.collectionId,
        toolId: params.toolId,
        metadata: params.metadata as Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Never throw - activity logging should never break main operations
    console.error('Failed to log activity:', error);
  }
}

/**
 * Activity type to human-readable message mapping
 */
export const ACTIVITY_MESSAGES: Record<
  ActivityType,
  (targetName: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) => string
> = {
  AGENT_CREATED: (name) => `Created agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_UPDATED: (name) => `Updated agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_DELETED: (name) => `Deleted agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_CLONED: (name) => `Cloned agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_FORKED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.sourceAgentName
      ? `Forked agent "${meta.sourceAgentName}" as "${name}"`
      : `Forked agent as "${name}"`,
  AGENT_TOOL_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.toolName
      ? `Added tool "${meta.toolName}" to agent "${name}"`
      : `Added tool to agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_TOOL_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.toolName
      ? `Removed tool "${meta.toolName}" from agent "${name}"`
      : `Removed tool from agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_COLLECTION_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.collectionName
      ? `Added collection "${meta.collectionName}" to agent "${name}"`
      : `Added collection to agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_COLLECTION_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.collectionName
      ? `Removed collection "${meta.collectionName}" from agent "${name}"`
      : `Removed collection from agent "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_CREATED: (name) => `Created collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_UPDATED: (name) => `Updated collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_DELETED: (name) => `Deleted collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_CLONED: (name) => `Cloned collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_FORKED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.sourceCollectionName
      ? `Forked collection "${meta.sourceCollectionName}" as "${name}"`
      : `Forked collection as "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.toolName
      ? `Added tool "${meta.toolName}" to collection "${name}"`
      : `Added tool to collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_TOOL_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.toolName
      ? `Removed tool "${meta.toolName}" from collection "${name}"`
      : `Removed tool from collection "${name}"`,
  TOOL_LIKED: (name) => `Liked tool "${name}"`,
  TOOL_UNLIKED: (name) => `Unliked tool "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_LIKED: (name) => `Liked collection "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_UNLIKED: (name) => `Unliked collection "${name}"`,
  AGENT_LIKED: (name) => `Liked agent "${name}"`,
  AGENT_UNLIKED: (name) => `Unliked agent "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_TOOLS_BULK_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.count
      ? `Added ${meta.count} tools from "${meta.packageName}" to collection "${name}"`
      : `Bulk added tools to collection "${name}"`,
  API_KEY_CREATED: (name) => `Created API key "${name}"`,
  API_KEY_DELETED: (name) => `Deleted API key "${name}"`,
  COLLECTION_ENV_UPDATED: (name) => `Updated environment variables on "${name}"`,
  AGENT_CONFIG_UPDATED: (name) => `Updated configuration for agent "${name}"`,
  BRIDGE_CONNECTED: () => 'Bridge connected',
  BRIDGE_DISCONNECTED: () => 'Bridge disconnected',
  TOOL_EXECUTED: (name, meta) =>
    meta?.source ? `Executed "${name}" via ${meta.source}` : `Executed "${name}"`,
  AGENT_CONVERSATION_STARTED: (name) => `Started conversation with "${name}"`,
};

/**
 * Activity type to icon name mapping (for UI)
 */
export const ACTIVITY_ICONS: Record<ActivityType, string> = {
  AGENT_CREATED: 'plus',
  AGENT_UPDATED: 'pencil',
  AGENT_DELETED: 'trash',
  AGENT_CLONED: 'copy',
  AGENT_FORKED: 'gitFork',
  AGENT_TOOL_ADDED: 'link',
  AGENT_TOOL_REMOVED: 'unlink',
  AGENT_COLLECTION_ADDED: 'folderPlus',
  AGENT_COLLECTION_REMOVED: 'folderMinus',
  COLLECTION_CREATED: 'folderPlus',
  COLLECTION_UPDATED: 'pencil',
  COLLECTION_DELETED: 'trash',
  COLLECTION_CLONED: 'copy',
  COLLECTION_FORKED: 'gitFork',
  COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED: 'link',
  COLLECTION_TOOL_REMOVED: 'unlink',
  TOOL_LIKED: 'heart',
  TOOL_UNLIKED: 'heartOff',
  COLLECTION_LIKED: 'heart',
  COLLECTION_UNLIKED: 'heartOff',
  AGENT_LIKED: 'heart',
  AGENT_UNLIKED: 'heartOff',
  COLLECTION_TOOLS_BULK_ADDED: 'folderPlus',
  API_KEY_CREATED: 'key',
  API_KEY_DELETED: 'key',
  COLLECTION_ENV_UPDATED: 'edit',
  AGENT_CONFIG_UPDATED: 'edit',
  BRIDGE_CONNECTED: 'link',
  BRIDGE_DISCONNECTED: 'link',
  TOOL_EXECUTED: 'terminal',
  AGENT_CONVERSATION_STARTED: 'message',
};

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  email         String    @unique
  emailVerified Boolean   @default(false) @map("email_verified")
  image         String?
  username      String?   @unique @db.VarChar(30) // URL-friendly username (nullable for migration)

  // Tier for rate limiting and feature access
  tier          UserTier  @default(FREE)

  // Role for access control (admin dashboard, etc.)
  role          UserRole  @default(USER)

  // Signup source tracking (e.g., 'github', 'google', 'direct')
  signupSource  String?   @map("signup_source") @db.VarChar(50)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  sessions         Session[]
  accounts         Account[]
  collections      Collection[]
  agents           Agent[]
  apiKeys          UserApiKey[]
  toolLikes        ToolLike[]
  toolRatings      ToolRating[]
  toolReviews      ToolReview[]
  collectionLikes  CollectionLike[]
  agentLikes       AgentLike[]
  activities       UserActivity[]
  bridgeConnection BridgeConnection?
  tpmjsApiKeys     TpmjsApiKey[]     @relation("UserTpmjsApiKeys")
  usageSummaries   ApiUsageSummary[] @relation("UserUsageSummaries")
  memories         Memory[]
  customMcpServers CustomMcpServer[]

  @@index([username])
  @@map("users")
}

/// Session table - stores user sessions
model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime @map("expires_at")
  ipAddress String?  @map("ip_address")
  userAgent String?  @map("user_agent")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("sessions")
}

/// Account table - stores auth provider accounts (including email/password)
model Account {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String    @map("user_id")
  accountId    String    @map("account_id")
  providerId   String    @map("provider_id")
  accessToken  String?   @map("access_token") @db.Text
  refreshToken String?   @map("refresh_token") @db.Text
  idToken      String?   @map("id_token") @db.Text
  expiresAt    DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  password     String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("accounts")
}

/// Verification table - stores email verification tokens
model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime @map("expires_at")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@map("verifications")
}
